# Pinned External Inputs

Every test oracle, schema source, runner binary, container image, and build input used by a
normative gate is pinned here by immutable source commit and/or artifact digest. Branch heads,
mutable tags without resolved digests, and `latest` are rejected by release tooling.

## Lock Files

- `ruby-3.4.11.json` — development/CI Ruby source archive and checksum
- `kubernetes-v1.36.2.json` — upstream source, Conformance definition, and official image
- `conformance-runners.json` — Hydrophone and Sonobuoy release artifacts
- `m7-microvm-artifacts.json` — Firecracker v1.16.1 release binaries (verified against the published SHA256SUMS), the pinned guest kernel (Linux 6.1.128 built from the verified source with the Firecracker CI config plus Landlock/PSI/dm-verity), the guest rootfs (digest-pinned ruby:3.4-alpine base, this repository's lib/ tree and musl-built ABI extension) and its dm-verity hash tree and root hash; regenerated by `rake m7:artifacts`

## M2 lifecycle oracle

- `kind-v0.33.0.json` — kind release binary (sha256), tag commit, and default base image digest used to build and provision the oracle node
- `m2-lifecycle-node-image.json` — digest-pinned Kubernetes v1.36.2 node image built from the pinned source checkout (kubelet/kubeadm/kube-apiserver/etcd/containerd/runc/kindnetd), build inputs, binary sha256 of containerd/runc/kubelet, and CRI image identities
- `m2-lifecycle-cni.json` — the only CNI the oracle may use: kindnetd (kind source commit, image digest, rendered `10-kindnet.conflist` sha256, chained plugin binary sha256); `runner_contract.json` refuses host defaults
- `m2-lifecycle-oracle-runner.json` — optional; only needed when `RUBERNETES_M2_LIFECYCLE_ORACLE_COMMAND` names an external runner argv (the built-in `runner.rb` needs no lock)

Regenerate the node-image and CNI locks with
`RUBERNETES_M2_KUBERNETES_SOURCE=/tmp/kubernetes-v1.36.2 ruby test/conformance/kubernetes/m2_lifecycle_oracle/node_image.rb --write-lock`
(see `test/conformance/kubernetes/m2_lifecycle_oracle/README.md`).
